parent_objective: materialize a metric-selected validation preflight over the M2413 reset target set without policy rollout
blocked_by: fresh measured validation needs workload/reset preflight under soft-boundary env config
actual success cannot be claimed until executed rollout
M2442 synthesis requires fresh preflight evidence before another same-data audit
supersedes: direct full measured rollout without preflight

public_gates: M2443 must materialize metric-selected workload/preflight artifacts from M2413 lineage
M2443 must use soft_offtrack_metric_enabled true and soft_offtrack_tolerance_m 0.20 in generated env configs
M2443 must validate config build/reset and actor observation shape without policy action
M2443 must not run measured policy rollout, repair, train, rank candidates/controllers, select winners, or make verdict claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run measured policy rollout
do not inject hidden or oracle actor features
do not claim actual success improvement
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not claim scenario redesign executed
do not claim training repair success

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: produces fresh workload/reset preflight evidence under the opt-in hard/soft metric config
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: validation preflight only; no measured policy rollout, actual success claim, repair execution, training, ranking, paper verdict, finite-window-vs-GRU, self-ID, scenario-redesign-executed, training-repair, or current-sim verdict claim
stop_condition: stop if preflight cannot build soft-boundary configs
stop if actor observation shape changes
stop if implementation executes policy action
stop if implementation claims measured success
fallback_plan: route to result audit if preflight passes
route to config/env support repair if preflight fails
stop for user review if no bounded validation route is supported

admission_evidence: M2441 soft-boundary env support focused tests passed
M2440 selected 0.20 m primary tolerance and M2413 350 x 15 denominator
allowed_updates: M2443 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the implementation result
next_stage_criteria: a bounded result-audit route is registered

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2443 validates task metric configs and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2443; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU verdict is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M2442 synthesis and M2441 soft-boundary support.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If preflight fails, repair config/env support or stop before measured rollout.
allowed_claims: no actual success improvement, controller ranking, candidate-family ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, scenario-redesign-executed result, training-repair result, current-sim verdict, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: produces fresh preflight/reset evidence under the metric-selected config
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can admit full measured-validation design; cannot itself establish current-sim or paper verdict
must_synthesize_if: preflight cannot choose result audit or stop
policy action or measured rollout is accidentally executed

hypothesis: A metric-selected validation preflight can materialize and reset-test the M2413 denominator under soft-boundary config without running policy rollout.
success_criteria: workload rows cover the M2413 350 x 15 denominator or fail closed with explicit coverage gaps
soft-boundary env configs build and reset
a bounded non-ranking next route is selected
no measured policy rollout repair training ranking actual-success or verdict claim is made
failure_criteria: M2443 executes policy action or measured policy rollout
M2443 ranks candidate families or controllers
M2443 treats preflight reset as actual success
M2443 makes current-sim, paper, FW-vs-GRU, or self-ID verdict claims
decision_rule: M2443 passes if it produces a complete metric-selected validation preflight and route without measured policy rollout, repair, training, ranking, actual-success, or verdict claims.
